Method of Attack: Phishing emails impersonating Russian Federal Bailiffs Service to deliver malware
Dropping a lightweight, stealthy JavaScript RAT with a C# keylogger
Use of loader files fetching obfuscated payloads (JavaScript backdoor and PowerShell keylogger)
Employing domain generation algorithm (DGA) for C2 domains to evade detection
Impacted Systems: Telecommunication service providers and industrial firms in Lithuania, Estonia, and Russia
Attack Vector: Phishing emails with malicious ZIP attachments containing executables
Indicators of Compromise: Sender address imitating Russian Ministry of Justice (e.g., mail@r77.fssprus.ru)
ZIP attachments named 'Исполнительный лист XXXXXXX-22' or 'Счет 63711-21 от 30.12.2021.zip'
